calculate_prompt_features: calculate the prompt length and reasoning sophistication score for a given prompt string
load_prompt_config: load a prompt text file and its matching dataset YAML configuration
load_hf_dataset: load a HuggingFace dataset from a configuration dictionary with streaming support
evaluate_prompt: evaluate a prompt against a dataset subset and return accuracy for GSM8K or HotpotQA
evaluate_stage1: run a quick stage 1 evaluation of a prompt using 10 samples
